start: Member page of a member whose gym plan is running; the gym sells a PT plan

steps.action: Tap 'Renew' (or 'Sell membership'), then pick the PT plan in 'Plan'
user_sees: A line 'PT · <n> sessions · Trainer <name>' (or 'PT · 1 session') followed by '. It runs along with their gym plan.'
'Starts on' jumps to today, not to the day after the gym plan ends
Price, joining fee and received boxes are emptied
must_not: The PT pack started after the gym plan ends
'sessions' written for one session
A typed price from the plan chosen before kept for this plan

user_sees: No refusal about the gym plan that is running
Message 'Membership saved. Receipt <number>.'
The member page shows the PT pack with its sessions beside the gym plan
must_not: 'Their plan already runs till …' for a PT pack
The gym plan's dates changed
A PT pack saved without its sessions or trainer

start: Member page, PT card of a member whose pack has run out; that PT plan is still on sale

user_sees: Sheet opens with that PT plan already picked
Title 'Renew membership' while a PT pack that is not cancelled exists
'Starts on' today
must_not: The first plan of the list picked instead
The gym plan's renewal date used as the start

user_sees: A new pack with a fresh session count
The old pack stays as it ended
must_not: Unused sessions of the old pack added to or taken from the new one without a word
Two new packs

start: Member page of a member with a PT pack whose plan the owner has taken off sale

user_sees: No 'Renew PT' button
must_not: A Renew PT button that opens the sheet on some other plan

steps.action: Open the sell sheet, pick another PT plan, type more than the total in 'Received now', tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'Amount received is more than the total.'
must_not: A receipt bigger than the pack price

steps.action: Type 0 as the price, tap Confirm
user_sees: The pack is saved free, no receipt, no due
must_not: A due or a reminder for zero

start: Member whose only PT pack was cancelled

steps.action: Open the sell sheet and pick the PT plan
user_sees: Title 'Sell membership' (a cancelled pack is not a renewal)
'Starts on' today
must_not: Title 'Renew membership' for a member with no live pack

steps.action: Save it, then open the sheet again on the PT plan
user_sees: Title 'Renew membership'
Start is still today: a second pack may run beside the first
must_not: The second pack refused as overlapping
The joining fee asked again after one was paid
